markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 没亲眼看到，但根据线索去猜。想象一把尺子：**must 是「肯定是」**，**might / may / could 是「可能是」**，**can't 是「肯定不是」**。

uses.en_zh: 坐了那趟飞机，你肯定累了。
那不可能是汤姆，他在休假。

now.title: 猜现在
now.text: 猜现在的事：情态动词后面跟**动词原形**，最常见的是 **be**。先找线索，再决定用尺子上的哪一格。

items.rule: 线索：灯亮着 → 肯定在
items.en: The lights are on. She [[must]] ((be)) at home.

items.zh: 他可能知道答案，问问他。

items.rule: 线索：刚吃过 → 肯定不饿
items.en: You [[can't]] ((be)) hungry. You've just had lunch!
items.zh: 你不可能饿，你刚吃过午饭！

now.tip: might、may、could 三个意思差不多，都是「可能」，随便挑一个都行。

doing.title: 猜「正在做」
doing.text: 猜别人**此刻正在干什么**，用 must / might / can't 加 **be doing**。

examples.en: He's not answering. He [[must be driving]].
examples.zh: 他不接电话，肯定在开车。

examples.en: She [[might be working]] from home today.
They [[can't be sleeping]] — it's only seven.
examples.zh: 他们不可能在睡觉，才七点。

past.title: 猜过去
past.text: 猜**已经发生**的事，把后面换成 **have + 过去分词**。就像把尺子搬回过去用：must have done、might have done、can't have done。

items.en: The build is green. Someone [[must have fixed]] it.
items.zh: 构建通过了，肯定有人修好了。

items.en: I can't find my keys. I [[might have left]] them at work.
items.zh: 我找不到钥匙了，可能落在公司了。

items.en: She [[can't have seen]] my message. She's still offline.
items.zh: 她不可能看到我的消息，她一直没上线。

notes: 说的时候常连读：must've /ˈmʌstəv/、might've /ˈmaɪtəv/，听着像 must of，但写的时候一定是 have。

negative.title: 肯定不是：can't
negative.text: 推测「肯定不是」用 **can't**，不用 mustn't。mustn't 是「不许」，意思完全不一样。「可能不是」用 **might not**。

items.zh: 他可能还不知道这个改动。

items.rule: 过去肯定没有：couldn't have done 也行

wrong.bad: That ~~mustn't~~ be Tom. He's in Paris.

that.en: He [[must have been]] at the office.

commonMistakes.why: 猜「可能是」用 might / may / could，不用 can。
情态动词后面永远是 have，不是 has。

quiz.prompt: You've been travelling for 20 hours. You ___ be exhausted.
I'm not sure why the app is slow. It ___ be the network.
You ___ be hungry. You've just had lunch!（肯定不）
翻译：灯亮着，她肯定在家。
quiz.answer: The lights are on. She must be at home.
accept: The lights are on, so she must be at home.
The lights are on. She must be home.
The light is on. She must be at home.

quiz.prompt: She ___ from home today. Her laptop isn't here.
quiz.explain: 猜此刻正在做：[[might be working]]。

quiz.prompt: The build is green now. Someone must ___ (fix) it.

traps.note: 情态动词后面不能直接跟过去式，要用 have fixed。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He must went home early.
quiz.answer: He must have gone home early.

quiz.prompt: 用 might have 改写：Maybe I left my keys at work.
quiz.answer: I might have left my keys at work.
accept: I may have left my keys at work.
I could have left my keys at work.

quiz.prompt: 改错：That mustn't be Tom. He's in Paris.
quiz.answer: That can't be Tom. He's in Paris.
accept: That cannot be Tom. He's in Paris.
That can't be Tom. He is in Paris.

quiz.prompt: She ___ (see) my message. She's been offline all day.（肯定没有）
quiz.explain: 过去肯定没有：[[can't have seen]]。

quiz.prompt: He ___ know about the change. Let's tell him just in case.
Which sentence is a guess, not a rule?
quiz.explain: 看到长得像才猜的，是推测：[[must]] ((be))。

quiz.prompt: 改错：He might has left already.
改错：You must have forget your password.
quiz.answer: You must have forgotten your password.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：他肯定已经回家了。
accept: He must have gone home already.
He must have already gone home.

openTask.prompt: 想象你早上来到公司，发现三件奇怪的事（比如构建突然通过了、同事没来、桌上有蛋糕）。用 must / might / can't 各写一句猜一猜，至少一句猜过去（have done）。
rules: 推测现在用 must / might / can't + 原形，推测过去用 + have + 过去分词
openTask.note: 规则判推测的形式和 can't / mustn't（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
